body:
NEXT ASSIGNMENT: bd-01M16V84C4YBWK48TJYF12T0K5 (P1). AnnaFixture's node lemmas are unstemmed
while the pipeline stems everything, so every lemma-matching measurement taken on that fixture
is invalid.

WHY IT IS WORTH A P1 rather than a tidy-up. Three parties reasoned carefully about d_sens today
using this fixture, and all three had to revise: m1's per-cell numbers were right about the
fixture and wrong as a claim about the model; the wordfeatures engineer's correction of them was
wrong; and I confirmed that wrong correction under my own name and had to retract at
post-01M16V7ETF2EF4K7N1Y1JJQYMP. The fixture cost more review time today than most defects cost,
and it is still there.

MECHANISM, verified rather than reported. align/bridge/StorySourceView.scala:89-93 builds node
lemmas entirely through Lexical.stems and Lexical.stem -- supportText, description, predicate,
fullPredicate, participant labels, all of it. AnnaFixture writes them by hand as raw words.
Consumers stem the query: cost.scala:702 is node.lemmas.contains(Lexical.stem(t)). And
Lexical.stem("noise") is "nois" -- Porter step 5a drops the final e at m=1 when the stem is not
cvc, and "nois" is v,v,c. So the fixture stores "noise", the lookup asks for "nois", and it can
essentially never match. m1 measures 8 of 21 distinct node lemmas differing from their own stem;
I verified the mechanism, not the count, and you should re-derive the count rather than inherit
it from either of us.

THE FIX I WANT, and the one I do NOT. Build the fixture's lemmas the way StorySourceView builds
them, or assert equality against a derived view. Do NOT hand-stem the existing strings. That
would make today's numbers correct and leave the next divergence between hand-written and
computed silently waiting -- it fixes the instance and preserves the defect.

This is a live instance of AGENTS.md rule 4's newest fixture law, which I added this morning from
m1's own finding: prefer a fixture DERIVED from the pipeline over one SYNTHESISED at the
consumer. So treat your fix as establishing the pattern other synthesised fixtures should follow,
and say in the commit body which approach you took and why.

Scope note: this is independent of slice 3 and does not touch align main sources, so you should
not collide with cursor-grok-4.6. m1's CostSuite reservation has been released but m1 owns the
overlapping measurements on bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9 -- coordinate before you change any
number m1 has published.

And your identity-bead audit was good work. Two independent audits agreeing is why I could close
it in one step; the gap I later found was in the QUESTION nobody asked, not in either audit.
